description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Theme' within the Opencart Admin Model namespace that manages theme records in the database, including operations such as adding, editing, deleting, retrieving, and counting themes.
external_files: database connection and query execution via $this->db

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Represents a model responsible for managing theme data in the database, providing CRUD operations and status updates for theme records.

methods.name: addTheme
methods.description: Inserts a new theme record into the database and returns the inserted theme's ID.

methods.name: editTheme
methods.description: Updates an existing theme record identified by theme_id with new data.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a theme identified by theme_id.

methods.name: deleteTheme
methods.description: Deletes a theme record from the database by theme_id.

methods.name: deleteThemesByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all themes associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves a theme record by theme_id.

methods.name: getThemes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of theme records, optionally paginated.

methods.name: getTotalThemes
methods.description: Returns the total count of theme records in the database.
